info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Utility Billing Disputes-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of utility billing disputes, allowing consumers to efficiently access and review disputes related to their billing. It serves as a vital tool for customer service representatives and finance teams handling dispute resolutions. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their operations, ensuring quick access to comprehensive details of each dispute. Typical use cases involve checking the status of open disputes or retrieving historical dispute records for analysis and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific billing dispute. It provides all relevant data including status, amount, and any notes associated with the dispute. Use this to track or manage ongoing billing disputes effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve billing dispute information. It should include all necessary parameters for identifying the specific dispute being queried.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: The request body for the operation to retrieve billing dispute information in JSON format. This should be a string that may contain the relevant details about the request.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_200.title: Billing Dispute Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the dispute.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the dispute operation.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response structure for a successful billing dispute operation.
